subject: history_social
passage: In June 1802, the Prussian naturalist Alexander von Humboldt and his companions set out to climb Chimborazo, a volcano in present-day Ecuador that many Europeans then believed to be the highest mountain on Earth. Although a deep ravine forced the party to turn back at roughly 5,900 meters, several hundred meters short of the ______ climbed higher than any European was known to have climbed before, and the observations Humboldt made on the mountain's slopes later shaped his famous diagram of how plant life changes with elevation.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The sentence begins with the subordinating conjunction "Although," so everything up to "several hundred meters short of the summit" is a dependent clause. The main clause is "they had climbed higher than any European …" An introductory dependent clause is joined to the main clause with a comma, even when the dependent clause contains commas of its own.
explanation.A: Correct. The comma correctly links the introductory "Although" clause to the main clause that follows.
explanation.B: Incorrect. A semicolon must join two independent clauses, but the "Although" clause is dependent.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The period leaves "Although a deep ravine forced the party … short of the summit" as a sentence fragment.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A colon must follow an independent clause, and the "Although" clause is not one.
